description:
A two-volume DVD/CD collection of character songs and music videos of Xbox 360 dating simulation game Dream C Club. The anime will recreate the heroines of the game with two-dimensional graphics.

Each Volume contains 3 clips.
Volume 1 contains:
Chapter 1 "Sweetx2☆Summer" featuring the characters Amane and Setsu,
Chapter 2 "Ikenai Lipstick" featuring the characters Rui and Reika,
Chapter 3 "koi・ＫＯＩ☆week end" (Original Short Ver.)

Volume 2 contains:
Chapter 1 "real" featuring the characters ,
Chapter 2 "Kanpai☆LOVE" featuring the characters Riho and Nao
Chapter 3 "Time Traveler" featuring the characters Airi and Mari.
